head.title: spaCR: spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 screens
head.description: spaCR {{SPACR_VERSION}}: segmentation, single-cell measurement, classification, barcode mapping and regression for image-based pooled CRISPR screens. Pipeline, published models, screen results, papers and installation.
tabs.label: spaCR sections
mask.title: Mask generator
overview.lede: Spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 screens.
overview.prose: spaCR segments cells, nuclei and pathogens in microscopy images, measures every object, and links the measurements to the guide RNAs sequenced from the same wells. It starts from plate images and FASTQ reads and ends with per-cell measurements, trained classifiers and a ranked list of genes.

ov.flow.title: What spaCR does
ov.flow.intro: Seven modules, run in order. Each one reads the previous module's output and writes its own into the same project folder. Segmentation, measurement, annotation and classification also run without sequencing data.

screen.perm.title: Permutation tests
screen.perm.intro: spaCR's guide-permutation analysis (Regression, nonparametric inference) on the screen's MaxViT per-cell scores: each gene's and each guide's partial correlation with the well-mean score, given plate, row and column, against 2,000,000 within-plate Freedman–Lane permutations (seed 0). Layout as in the preprint's Figure S7 (panels R and S). With the example's shipped settings, control wells and guides stay in, so the numbers differ from the preprint, which excluded them and filtered wells. screen.perm.gene.caption: Gene level: 414 genes tested (each gene's summed guide fractions). 4 reach BH q < 0.05 (SAG1 (TGGT1_233460) r = −0.317, P = 5.0×10⁻⁷, q = 1.0×10⁻⁴; GRA14 (TGGT1_239740) r = +0.435, P = 5.0×10⁻⁷, q = 1.0×10⁻⁴; EAF1 (TGGT1_225160) r = +0.240, P = 1.0×10⁻⁶, q = 1.4×10⁻⁴; GRA12B (TGGT1_275860) r = +0.157, P = 1.7×10⁻⁴, q = 1.7×10⁻²); 3 also pass the effect cut: SAG1 (TGGT1_233460), GRA14 (TGGT1_239740), EAF1 (TGGT1_225160). 2 genes sit at the P floor (no permutation as extreme). 2,000,000 within-plate Freedman-Lane permutations, seed 0; smallest attainable P = 1/(B+1) = 5.0×10⁻⁷. MaxViT per-cell scores averaged per well, 1,290 wells on 4 plates, partial Pearson r given plate, row and column. Dashed line BH q = 0.05; dotted lines the spaCR effect cut (3x std of 29 controls = 0.221).
screen.perm.guide.alt: Guide-level permutation volcano: partial correlation against minus log10 BH-adjusted empirical P, coloured by compartment; GRA14 guides 1 and 3, SAG1 guide 4 and EAF1 guide 2 named.
screen.perm.guide.caption: Guide level: 953 guides tested. 3 reach BH q < 0.05 (SAG1 guide 4 r = −0.317, P = 5.0×10⁻⁷, q = 1.6×10⁻⁴; GRA14 guide 1 r = +0.397, P = 5.0×10⁻⁷, q = 1.6×10⁻⁴; GRA14 guide 3 r = +0.263, P = 5.0×10⁻⁷, q = 1.6×10⁻⁴); 3 pass the effect cut. 3 guides sit at the P floor. 2,000,000 within-plate Freedman-Lane permutations, seed 0; smallest attainable P = 1/(B+1) = 5.0×10⁻⁷. MaxViT per-cell scores averaged per well, 1,290 wells on 4 plates, partial Pearson r given plate, row and column. Dashed line BH q = 0.05; dotted lines the spaCR effect cut (3x std of 29 controls = 0.221).
screen.perm.null.alt: Three histograms of the permutation null of the partial correlation, for GRA14, EAF1 and SAG1, each with the observed value far outside the null.
screen.perm.null.caption: Permutation null of the gene-level partial correlation for GRA14, EAF1 and SAG1 (2,000,000 draws, seed 0; log count scale). Solid line: observed r; dashed: -r (the test is two-sided on |r|). b = permutations at least as extreme; P = (b+1)/(B+1). GRA14 r = +0.435, b = 0; EAF1 r = +0.240, b = 1; SAG1 r = −0.317, b = 0. phenotypes.intro: Every measured cell can be placed on a two-dimensional map with its image crop, so that groups of similar cells can be found and checked by eye.

phenotypes.cls.title: Classification
phenotypes.cls.intro: Classifiers that tell the screen's control wells apart, trained and explained with spaCR on CPU: an XGBoost model on per-cell measurements and a small image model (MobileNetV3-small, 8 epochs) on single-cell crops. Column 1 wells carry guides against SAG1 (negative control) and column 2 wells against GRA14 (positive control). Wells are held out whole, so no test cell shares a well with a training cell. Data: spacr-example-screen and spacr-example-hit, plate 1, CC BY 4.0.

about.title: About
about.intro: This site presents spaCR and related microscopy projects: software, segmentation models and hardware, with the data and code behind each figure.
about.affiliation_text: Research Investigator, Department of Microbiology & Immunology, University of Michigan
about.bio_text: Einar B. Olafsson is a Research Investigator in the Department of Microbiology & Immunology at the University of Michigan. He studies how Toxoplasma gondii interacts with the cells it infects, combining CRISPR screening, high-content microscopy and AI-based single-cell image analysis to link genetic perturbations to spatial cellular phenotypes. He created and maintains spaCR. He studied biology and immunology at Uppsala University and received his PhD in Molecular Biosciences from Stockholm University, with a thesis on signalling in Toxoplasma dissemination by infected immune cells.

mc.read.title: How to read these scores
mc.read.precision_recall: Precision is the share of objects the model reported that match a reference object; low precision means false detections. Recall is the share of reference objects the model found; low recall means missed objects.
mc.read.f1: F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, so it is high only when both are. Either alone can look near-perfect: a model that reports one obvious object has high precision, and one that reports every dark blob has high recall.
mc.read.iou: IoU (intersection over union) is the overlap between a predicted and a reference object divided by the area the two cover together. F1 at IoU 0.5 counts an object as found when that ratio reaches 0.5.
mc.read.iou75: F1 at IoU 0.75 counts an object only when the ratio reaches 0.75, so the outline has to fit more closely.
mc.read.ap: Average precision at one IoU threshold is true positives divided by true positives, false positives and false negatives together. mAP averages it over several thresholds, so it also rewards outlines that fit closely.
mc.read.aji: AJI (aggregated Jaccard index) adds up the overlap of every matched pair and divides it by their combined area plus the area of unmatched objects, so merged, split and missed objects all lower it.
mc.read.dice: Dice is twice the overlap divided by the predicted area plus the reference area.
mc.read.map: mAP at IoU 0.5 is the mean average precision of the predicted boxes when a box counts as correct at an IoU (overlap divided by the area the two boxes cover together) of 0.5 or more. mAP at IoU 0.5 to 0.95 averages it over ten thresholds, so loosely placed boxes score lower.
mc.read.boxes: Precision is the share of predicted boxes that match a reference box; low precision means false boxes. Recall is the share of reference boxes the model found; low recall means missed wells.
mc.read.count: Median count error is the median difference between the predicted and the reference count per plate, as a percentage of the reference. Plates within 5% or 10% is the share of plates whose count error stays inside that limit.
mc.read.baseline: The grey bar is the baseline named in the column header, scored on the same test images: stock Cellpose-SAM without fine-tuning, or an earlier model where no stock model has the class.
mc.read.cv: Cross-validated scores split the data into folds, hold out each fold once and report the mean over folds with its standard deviation (SD). A single split can mislead; the SD shows how far the score moves from one split to another.
mc.read.heldout: The held-out test set is images kept out of training and used only for scoring.

mask.intro3: Drop in an image and get masks from a spaCR model: one page per model class. Run it entirely in your browser (WebGPU, nothing is uploaded), or open it in Google Colab, where the real spaCR pipeline runs on Google's free GPU under your own Google account. The download is a ZIP with the image, the mask, the flows, the cell probability, a per-object CSV and a README.
mask.input.toxoplasma_pv: One fluorescence channel showing the parasite vacuoles (for example a parasite or vacuole marker), 20x to 60x, TIFF or PNG.
mask.input.toxoplasma_plaque: Bright-field or gel-documenter image of a plaque well or plate, grey or RGB, TIFF, PNG or JPEG.
mask.input.toxoplasma_well_detector: Photo or scan of a whole plate, grey or RGB, PNG, JPEG or TIFF; the model returns one box per well.
mask.input.cell_from_hoechst: One Hoechst (DNA) channel; the model outlines whole cells from it. 20x is the magnification it was trained at.
mask.input.nuclei_from_cellmask: One CellMask (membrane) channel; the model outlines nuclei from it. 20x is the magnification it was trained at.
mask.input.toxoplasma_from_cellmask: One CellMask (membrane) channel; the model outlines parasite vacuoles from it.
mask.input.toxoplasma_from_hoechst: One Hoechst (DNA) channel; the model outlines parasite vacuoles from it.
mask.input.live_cell: One transmitted-light channel (phase contrast, bright field or DIC).

mask.defaults: Blank numeric fields and Desktop default keep the model's desktop settings. Intensity values use original image units.
mask.postprocess: Building masks and packaging the ZIP…
mask.labels: Original upload, selected image, label TIFF, object measurements CSV, README and provenance. Flows and cell scores are included only when the model returns them; cell scores may be raw logits, not calibrated probabilities.
mask.boxes: Original upload, selected image, detection boxes and confidence scores, CSV, README and provenance. This detector returns boxes, not segmentation masks, flows or cell probabilities.
mask.browser_note2: The browser route runs the same model weights exported to ONNX with the same normalization, tiling and Cellpose mask dynamics; the shared-perimeter merge and additional JSON object filters run only in the spaCR desktop app.
mask.snapshot: Scores are copied from the published model snapshot, not recomputed here. Compare only the test sets described in each model card.
mask.err_model: The model could not be downloaded or verified. Check your connection and try again.
mask.err_memory2: The browser ran out of memory. Try a smaller image, or Google Colab.
mask.err_diameter: Enter the plaque diameter in pixels, or choose native scale.
mask.err_json: The additional desktop settings are not valid JSON.
mask.err_desktop_only: The shared-perimeter merge and additional JSON filters run only in the spaCR desktop app.

mc.group.pv.motivation.6d6d3b: Stock Cellpose-SAM (cpsam_v2) misses or misdraws many Toxoplasma parasitophorous vacuoles. In the re-score of 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth, each model is scored on the fields it never saw in training or validation (the sets differ between models), and stock cpsam_v2 on the same fields. Stock scores F1 0.364 to 0.402 at IoU 0.5, against 0.793 for v1, 0.713 for v2, 0.750 for v3, 0.761 for v4 and 0.733 for v5.
mc.note.84f632: Re-scored on 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth: 209 strict hold-out fields pooled, at IoU 0.5, with stock on the same fields. Earlier scores on other sets are superseded.
mc.testsrc.02f4f5: ground-truth re-score of 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth: fields this model never saw in training or validation, pooled over all fields, IoU 0.5; the stock model scored on the same fields
mc.testsize.0b07bf: 209 strict hold-out fields (41 with no object)
mc.group.plaque.motivation.e8fdef: Stock Cellpose-SAM scores F1 0.128 to 0.338 at IoU 0.5 on crystal violet plaque fields in the re-score of 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth. Each model is scored on the fields it never saw in training or validation (the sets differ between models), and stock on the same fields: 0.707 for v1 against stock cpsam 0.258, 0.455 for v2 against 0.189, 0.732 for v3 against 0.128 and 0.765 for v4 against stock cpsam_v2 0.338.
mc.testsrc.a86669: strict: the test split of the curated plaque dataset of 2026-10-15 (einarolafsson/toxoplasma-plaque-curated-2026-10-15, revision 91d4f1cd), grouped by source paper or plate; never used for training or checkpoint selection
mc.group.wells.motivation.89fe02: The plaque module first finds each well in a plate image or published figure and then segments plaques inside it; the detected well also gives the diameter that makes plaque areas comparable across microscopes. Stock YOLO has no plaque-well class, so each detector is compared with the one before it: on 129 held-out test images v2 scores mAP50 0.946 against v1's 0.884, with 49 false boxes on no-well images against 152.
mc.note.adbec0: On 3 Gel Doc validation plates mAP50-95 rises from 0.895 to 0.931; both models recover the expected well count on all 3.
mc.testsrc.efa670: incumbent validation images after removing exact and canonical-figure duplicates; validation data, not an independent test
mc.baselabel.613f50: previous version (well detector v1, the YOLO11n incumbent) on the same validation images
mc.group.crosschannel.motivation.eadff0: Cross-channel models predict one object type from another channel's image, so a stain can be left out and its channel used for another marker: cells from Hoechst alone, nuclei from a cell mask alone, and Toxoplasma vacuoles from either. Stock cpsam_v2 does not do this: on held-out fields its F1 at IoU 0.5 is 0.301, 0.201, 0.022 and 0.002 against 0.870, 0.888, 0.606 and 0.569 for the four trained models.
mc.note.ef3846: Precision 0.944 against recall 0.806: it misses cells rather than inventing them.
mc.testsrc.621b90: well-grouped held-out split (no well on both sides), hosts HFF, HeLa and THP1; the split also selected the checkpoint
mc.note.8c3691: Predicts nuclei from cell morphology; expect lower accuracy on unusual or highly confluent morphologies.
mc.note.adc031: Per host F1: HeLa 0.711, HFF 0.557, THP1 0.465.
mc.testsrc.783c50: well-grouped held-out split (no well on both sides), hosts HFF, HeLa and THP1, fields without parasites included; the split also selected the checkpoint
mc.note.87f90d: The Hoechst route is harder than the cell-mask route; compare Toxoplasma from Cell Mask.
mc.group.livecell.motivation.23371c: Segments unstained cells in phase contrast, brightfield and DIC images. On test datasets stock cpsam_v2 was not trained on, F1 at IoU 0.5 is 0.960 against 0.885 for stock; over all 2,199 test fields it is 0.694 against 0.738, because stock was trained on LIVECell and scores higher on it.
mc.note.4be607: On test datasets stock cpsam_v2 was not trained on, F1 0.960 against 0.885; stock was trained on LIVECell and scores higher there.
mc.testsrc.871738: transmitted-light test split grouped by acquisition (phase contrast, brightfield, DIC)
mc.group.other.motivation.d903ff: The colony detector (alpha) counts bacterial and fungal colonies on plate photos for colony counting. On 39 held-out plates with 30-300 colonies its median count error is 2.4% against 16.5% for spaCR's thresholding counter.
mc.note.04439e: One dataset and one split; confluent swarming colonies remain hard.
